package.name: so101_driver
package.description: ROS2 driver node for the SO-101 arm — wraps robot_sam2_app_v2 hardware.py. Phase 2 of the ROS2 Jazzy migration. Supports two backends: daemon — ZMQ → C++ motor_daemon (200 Hz PID, needs Linux rebuild, see TODO) feetech — direct lerobot Feetech serial on /dev/ttyACM* Defaults to dry_run=true so it never crashes without hardware.
